facts: Inferior reached native code and stopped on EXC_BREAKPOINT while emitting the compiler image. No stage2 image was written.
The imm function stopped at offset +884, the numeric success-tag guard after a 64-byte allocation fallback call. This is not a failed callable-signature guard.
The frozen build uses a 3 GiB managed heap. The last observed process RSS was 4231248 KiB; RSS is not a live-heap measurement.
Empty managed-surface requests unnecessarily traversed and cloned application syntax. A regression test observed two syntax-list accesses before the fix and zero afterward.
diagnosis: The allocation fallback returned a non-number result, consistent with allocation/capacity failure. The failed process did not retain a register dump, so the precise allocator return tag and exhaustion cause are not confirmed.
correction: prepareManagedSurfaceExports now returns immediately for an empty request, preserving the existing AST and avoiding the unused whole-application type traversal.
next: Validate the corrected current source in fresh native fixtures and a new frozen self-build. Preserve this failed observation; do not reuse its report or claim a fixed point.
